definitions.attacks_per_note: Duet note attacks (changes to a note >= 0) in [onset - W, onset + L], per her note
definitions.stumble: share of her notes where Duet attacks a note in [onset - W, onset] AND changes again in (onset, onset + L]: a wrong-then-corrected start
definitions.attack_harsh: share of her notes where the note sounding just after her onset was attacked in [onset - W, onset] and is a 2nd/tritone/7th against her true note
definitions.held_harsh: share of her notes where the note sounding just after her onset was held over from before onset - W and is a 2nd/tritone/7th against her true note
definitions.harsh_first_fresh / harsh_first_held: bench_rt's harsh_first split by whether the sounding note was attacked with her onset (fresh) or held over
